```yaml
name: Update Open-WebUI

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 0' # Weekly at midnight on Sunday
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  sync-open-webui:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Remove leftover submodule
        run: |
          git submodule deinit --all
          git rm -rf .git/modules
          git clean -fdx

      - name: Clone open-webui as shallow copy
        run: |
          git clone --depth=1 https://github.com/jrkropp/open-webui.git open-webui

      - name: Move open-webui to correct location
        run: mv open-webui/* .

      - name: Update contributor docs
        run: echo "New open-webui folder added" >> CONTRIBUTING.md

      - name: Mention automated sync in README
        run: echo "Automated sync of open-webui happens every week." >> README.md

      - name: Exclude cloned repo from builds
        run: echo "open-webui/" >> .gitignore

      - name: Test with nox
        run: pip install nox && nox -s lint tests
```
This GitHub Actions workflow will sync the `open-webui` repository weekly, update the contributor documentation, mention the automated sync in the README, exclude the cloned repository from builds, remove any leftover submodules, and test the project using `nox`.
